items.title: JPMorgan Chase (JPM) Backs Michigan LIFT As Dimon Pushes US Europe Trade Pact
items.summary: JPMorgan Chase (NYSE:JPM) CEO Jamie Dimon has called for a broad US Europe free trade pact aimed at countering China's influence. The bank has co founded the Michigan LIFT industrial initiative, which is focused on US manufacturing and supply chain projects. Dimon's trade push and JPMorgan Chase's Michigan LIFT role together mark a fresh attempt to shape both global and domestic economic policy.
